name: Round colour display 1.28in 240x240 (GC9A01, SPI)
description: 1.28 in round IPS colour display, 240 x 240 pixels (the corners are not on the glass), RGB565 on the GC9A01 controller over SPI. Uno wiring: VCC → 5V (or 3V3), GND → GND, SCL → D13, SDA → D11 (it is SPI MOSI, not I2C), RES → D8, DC → D9, CS → D10, BLK → 5V or a PWM pin. Draw with Adafruit_GFX (see the example), Adafruit_GC9A01A or TFT_eSPI.

pins.label: SCL
pins.description: SPI clock (labelled SCL, but it is SPI). Uno: D13.

pins.label: SDA
pins.description: SPI data in (labelled SDA, but it is SPI MOSI, not I2C). Uno: D11.

pins.label: RES
pins.description: Reset, active low, pulled up on the module. Uno: D8.

pins.label: DC
pins.description: Data / command select: LOW = command, HIGH = data. Uno: D9.

pins.label: CS
pins.description: Chip select, active low. Uno: D10.

pins.label: BLK
pins.description: Backlight: HIGH or unwired = on; analogWrite on a PWM pin dims it.

props.label: Logic level
props.description: Most GC9A01 modules are 3.3 V logic; on a 5 V Uno add series resistors or a level shifter for real hardware (choose 3v3-only to get the warning).

footprint: Round module about 36 mm across with an 8-pin 0.1 in header tab (VCC GND SCL SDA RES DC CS BLK)

bindings.description: The glass shows an image: powered, sleep out (0x11), display on (0x29) and backlight on.
Counts visible changes. Pixels: Simulation.framebuffer(partId) (RGB565, 240 x 240; corners off the glass stay black).
The rotation (0..3) MADCTL matches, using the GC9A01 table (0 = BGR only, 1 = MX|MV, 2 = MX|MY, 3 = MY|MV); -1 otherwise.
Pixels on the glass that are not black.
INVON register set (this glass needs it for true colours).
1 when the glass shows an image (bound in the SVG).
